// Sample module used by the lint tests.
// It shows each case the rules must handle.
const url = "https://example.com/a//b";
const slashes = '// not a comment /* nor this */';
const tpl = `# ${url} // still a template`;
const re = /\/\/ regex/;

/** jsdoc fails */
export function add(a: number, b: number): number {
  return a + b; // trailing fails
}

// eslint-disable-next-line no-console
console.log(add(1, 2));
// @ts-ignore
const x: number = "y";
// @ts-expect-error
const y: string = 1;
/* biome-ignore lint: reason */
const z = x + y;
const w = z; /* @ts-nocheck */
export { url, slashes, tpl, re, w };
